protocol:
1. Prepare the bench with an Invitrogen E-Gel EX cassette, an E-Gel Power Snap device with the red/orange lid open, an adjustable micropipette, sterile pipette tips, labeled microcentrifuge tubes in an ice bucket, and a white tube rack.

2. Attach a sterile disposable tip to the adjustable micropipette.

3. Remove a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the ice bucket and hold it upright near the pipette.

4. Open the labeled microcentrifuge tube and pipette liquid sample or reagent with the adjustable micropipette.

5. Return the labeled microcentrifuge tube to the ice bucket to keep it cold.

6. Pick up another labeled microcentrifuge tube from the white tube rack.

7. Open the tube and transfer liquid sample or reagent with the adjustable micropipette.

8. Place the tube back into the tube rack after pipetting.

9. Repeat liquid transfer with additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes from the ice bucket and rack using the adjustable micropipette.

10. Position the Invitrogen E-Gel EX cassette flat on the bench in front of the E-Gel Power Snap device.

11. Load prepared liquid sample from a labeled microcentrifuge tube into the wells of the E-Gel EX cassette using the adjustable micropipette.

12. Continue loading the E-Gel EX cassette wells with the remaining prepared sample or reagent from labeled microcentrifuge tubes.

13. Pick up the loaded E-Gel EX cassette from the bench.

14. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the cassette bay of the E-Gel Power Snap device.

15. Seat the cassette in the E-Gel Power Snap device with the red/orange chamber exposed.

16. Tap the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen to start the gel run.
